title: MoonStack — quiet software for a loud era
heroLede: MoonStack is a small-batch product house. For a decade we've been building software that respects two things the industry stopped respecting — your attention, and your data. Everything we ship has survived a drill most ideas never see.
drillSay: Five layers deep before we build — most ideas die there. Ours don't.
storyMeta: // the hype moved on; we never chased it
tl15v: At the OWASP Asia Summit in Beijing, a log-analysis and alerting system cut through the big-data noise and pointed the way. MoonStack shipped: security, operations, logs, alerting.
tl15zh: 日志纪 · 安全 · 运维 · 预警
tl19v: The hype moved on. We refused to fake a need. The moon went dark for years — but a dark moon is still a moon.
tl19zh: 沉默不是消亡 · 是拒绝伪需求
tlNowv: Concept inflation returns with the AI era. So do we — for language, for creation, for tools that made it through the drill.
tlNowzh: AI 时代 · 概念通胀 · 我们回来了
gyDesc: A language companion built around how you actually read, listen, and remember — not around someone else's curriculum. Learn the way you think.
gzDesc: AI-assisted video and content creation where every step stays inspectable and every output stays yours. See deep, create clear.
toolsLead: Five privacy-first Edge extensions — processing local-only, one-time Pro where paid, no subscriptions, no tracking.
philoZh: 静默奉献 · 改变世界
footFine: Each tool's privacy policy is linked beside it above. MoonStack tools run locally and do not collect personal data; where a tool fetches public data (e.g. SEC filings or Reddit posts), it does so directly from the source at your request. Not investment advice. This site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics for anonymous, cookieless visit counts — no personal data, no cross-site tracking.
